research_method_name_cn: 代理引导的结构化候选探索—预算约束UE重排序—局部校正框架

auxiliary_only: 集成成员分歧候选通道
forbidden_claims: 将成员分歧直接解释为认知风险
宣称每个辅助通道均有独立正贡献
宣称候选筛选能够直接召回精确最优序列

optimization_scope.conditional_optimum: over the preselected ten recoverable roads; other initially closed roads remain closed
optimization_scope.stage_objective: mean true-UE normalized excess TSTT over R0..R9; R10 has zero weight

final_scenario_generation.generator: NumPy Generator(PCG64), seed 2026080701, implemented by frozen formal_code/generate_final_holdout.py
acceptance_before_id_assignment: at least 10 initially closed physical roads
finite physically valid open-road factors and frozen closed-road sentinels
unique rounded-depth vector and unique closed mask
no scenario hash overlap with any prior scenario
final_scenario_generation.rejection_policy: reject and resample using the same RNG stream before assigning the next scenario_id; record every rejected draw and reason
final_scenario_generation.ordinary_scenarios: not part of the formal optimization holdout because the frozen optimization scope is severe scenarios with >=10 initially closed roads
final_scenario_generation.count_note: Day7验收建议可增至20个以增强统计稳定性；为避免冻结后改变研究口径，v1.1保留预注册的10个。

candidate_pool.proxy_ga_operationalization: mutate proxy-best candidates from the already frozen prefix/random/proxy-subset-DP registry
candidate_pool.validity: each sequence is a length-10 permutation of the selected roads; candidate_id and sequence unique within scenario

structural_reserve.cluster_order: ascending minimum proxy rank, then lexical prefix
structural_reserve.prefix3: all third-road extensions within selected prefix2 clusters

formal_full_method.prefix_exploration: evaluate common R0 and the ten selected prefix2 clusters; expand all eight prefix3 extensions for the four best true-UE prefix2 clusters before budget64 and the remaining six before budget128
formal_full_method.sequence_queue: source and proxy-rank-quantile stratified; no global proxy-rank scan

local_search.parents: current best five fully evaluated sequences by true-UE objective
moves: arbitrary swaps whose first index is in positions 1..5 and second is at least two later
insertions whose source index is in positions 1..5
local_search.priority: fewest missing UE states, adjacent before non-adjacent, lower indices, better parent objective
local_search.stop: two consecutive rounds with no evaluation or <0.1% global-best improvement, or current budget reached

methods.traditional_heuristic_ue: ten frozen heuristic-channel sequences; UE reranking; no local search
methods.surrogate_only: proxy-rank-1 sequence; no UE feedback during selection; objective added only after method-output freeze
methods.random_ue: fixed random-source candidate order using seed 2026080704+scenario_id; UE reranking; no local search
methods.proxy_topk_ue: ascending proxy rank; UE reranking; no local search
methods.no_local_search: full primary plus structural reserve and prefix exploration, but no neighborhood moves

ue_and_cache.information_budget_unit: method-specific unique restored-subset query; repeated requests within a method are hits
ue_and_cache.physical_compute_cache: may be shared across methods only after each method independently requests the state; cache contents are never enumerable by a method
ue_and_cache.failed_or_nonfinite_result: do not cache, do not score, stop formal run and report failure
ue_and_cache.state_hash: SHA-256 of round(depth_m,9) concatenated with 38-bit restored mask
ue_and_cache.fresh_namespace_rule: 正式最终运行必须使用新的场景专属空缓存；旧场景冒烟可显式启用warm-cache且必须标注smoke-test。

mandatory_execution_order: generate new scenarios and freeze input hashes
select ten roads and freeze road/candidate/screening hashes
run full method and five controls through live UE query interface
freeze every method output and method-specific query ledger
only then enumerate remaining states to complete 1024-state exact reference
run exact dynamic programming and calculate regret
publish all scenarios, including failures, without replacement

operator_may_inspect: UE convergence logs for requested states

final_metrics: physical UE solves and request-cache hits reported separately

predeclared_final_gates.interpretation: project-level gates, not universal journal standards; failure must be reported and cannot trigger replacement of this holdout

five_blockers_closed: 独立最终场景生成器与拒绝日志
最终10条可恢复道路确定器
候选与筛选脚本全部参数化
五类对照改为实时UE按需查询并独立冻结账本
完整方法及全部对照冻结后才允许构造1024态精确参考

old_scenario_smoke_test.reason: Day6已验证旧场景状态用于工程贯通测试，不作为最终性能证据

protocol_lineage.change_reason: 在生成任何最终场景前补齐正式入口、清单命名、独立验证器和完整归档结构；候选、筛选、预算、局部搜索、道路规则、目标函数、对照与门槛均未改变。
